subject: Arcadia Health — request for DR/RTO-RPO evidence and witness plan
messages:
From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@arcadiahealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: compliance@arcadiahealth.com
Date: 2026-09-14T15:22:00-04:00
Subject: Evidence for upcoming BCP audit — RTO/RPO and witness plan

Hi Soojin,

Arcadia Health is scheduling its annual third-party continuity audit for the week of Sep 28. As part of scope we need published RTO/RPO numbers, recent restore traces (last 12 months), runbooks for the prescribed recovery scenarios, and a witness plan (remote walk-through) that demonstrates your ability to meet the stated RTO/RPO.

Can you provide the following by EOW (Sep 17)?
- Consolidated RTO/RPO table for production services (table + explanation)
- Restore traces for the last two restore events (logs + summary)
- Runbook(s) for primary-to-secondary failover and warm-cache restore
- A 30–45 minute window for a remote witness on Sep 22–24

We may need redaction for any internal IPs/hostnames. I attached our audit scope spreadsheet for reference.

Thanks,
Marta Ruiz
Senior IT Auditor
Arcadia Health

Attachments: audit_requirements_arcadia.xlsx

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@arcadiahealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-14T17:05:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Evidence for upcoming BCP audit — RTO/RPO and witness plan

Hi Marta — thanks for the clear list. We'll assemble an evidence packet and provide a secure transfer link. Initial notes:
- We'll provide the RTO/RPO consolidated table with per-service caveats.
- Restore traces: we will include redacted logs and a one-page summary for each event.
- Runbooks: we'll include the current recovery runbook (v3) and a compact "witness script" that maps actions to timestamps.
- Witness windows: Sep 22 13:00–14:00 ET or Sep 23 09:00–10:00 ET work for us; which do you prefer?

I'll upload the packet to a secure share and send access instructions. Cc'ing Marcus (SRE) and Laura (TAM) to coordinate the walk-through and any engineering artifacts.

Sincerely,
Soojin Lee
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_rto_rpo_snapshot_20260801.csv, access_instructions.txt

From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@arcadiahealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-15T09:10:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Evidence for upcoming BCP audit — RTO/RPO and witness plan

Hi Soojin — Sep 22 13:00–14:00 ET works on our side. A couple of requests:
- Please redact internal IP addresses/hostnames from any logs or provide a redacted export.
- If possible, provide a brief mapping document that ties each artifact to the SIG/SOC2 control (we'll flag exact controls next day).
- We received the scope spreadsheet offline; thanks.

We will provide a short (10–12 person) attendee list the morning of the session.

Thanks,
Marta

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@arcadiahealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-15T11:45:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Evidence for upcoming BCP audit — RTO/RPO and witness plan

Hi Marta — confirmed Sep 22 13:00–14:00 ET. Upload completed; links below are time-limited (72 hours) and access is logged. We've redacted IPs/hostnames in the trace exports and included a redaction summary.

Access links and artifacts:
- Secure share (evidence packet): https://drive.redwood.com/share/secure/abc123
- RTO/RPO consolidated table: redwood_rto_rpo_snapshot_20260801.csv
- Recovery runbook: restore-runbook-v3.pdf
- Restore traces (redacted): failover-traces-20260601.log
- Transfer/access instructions: access_instructions.txt
- Mapping to SIG/SOC2 controls: mapping_sig_soc2_v1.docx (note: sensitive—limited distribution)

Notes on RTO/RPO:
- RTOs are measured from failover initiation to service-ready state; usual targets: 15 min for auth/cache tier, 60 min for full model bundle restore (cold).
- RPO: continuous KV checkpointing for session-store (<=15s), model cache snapshot restore within 10 min for warm caches; see runbook appendix for test timestamps.

Related ticket: HS-67890 (HubSpot). Please let us know if you'd like any additional redaction before the session. Marcus will run the live restore walk-through script and Laura will lead the Q&A for platform behavior.

Regards,
Soojin Lee
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: restore-runbook-v3.pdf, mapping_sig_soc2_v1.docx, failover-traces-20260601.log
